read_scope: parent task instructions and default clarifications only
context_exposure.evidence_usage: TwoNPZ inspected through /home/users/oscar/.pixi/bin/pixi run python. All16images individually viewed. No web/source inspection; external geometry statements are explicitly supplied static knowledge and common geometry.

combination_consideration.decision: Adopt deliberate combination asP3; retain P1/P2 as separate distinct mechanisms.
combination_consideration.why: P1 changes conditioning/action coordinates without future supervision; P2 adds joint learned future-geometry denoising while retaining world actions; P3 tests their combination under identical optimizer/update budget.
combination_consideration.rejected: No analytic tangent controller, success oracle or hard approach/open phases; only2successful demonstrations do not justify hard route thresholds. No whole-scene rotational augmentation because robot/table remain fixed.
combination_consideration.uncertainty: Extra predictive learning can hurt action imitation; dynamic handle-attached action frames were considered but rejected here because fixed end-effector orientation limits their physical symmetry and cabinet yaw provides a simpler fully declared frame.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: An orthonormal cabinet yaw frame expresses relative displacement and command directions consistently across yaw; known z-axis hinge does not imply whole-environment equivariance. Geometry source is task_materials.json source_knowledge and declared yaw fields; rotation algebra is common geometry.
Both image sequences approach above handle then descend before planar opening; object z stays0.15003595m. LL hand reaches~0.3274m and HH~0.3326m before descending.
Explicit cabinet-relative relations may reduce spurious correlation between door_x and yaw while retained world fields allow fixed robot constraints to be learned.

candidates.predicted_generalization_gain: May improve C cross-combinations and moderate yaw extrapolation through explicit relative features and rotated action coordinates; large yaw may still fail due to fixed-gripper reach/contact.

architecture.diffusion: single conditional 1D U-Net; widths [64,128,256], time embedding128, kernel5, groups8

observation_transform.raw: Concatenate unchanged declared raw41 fields, in meters/unitless, with14 engineered features; no per-D_N normalization, passthrough(all).
observation_transform.coordinate_definition: C(v)=(c*vx+s*vy,-s*vx+c*vy,vz), with (s,c)=normalize(raw[39:41]); fallback(0,1) only for norm<1e-8. C inverse(v)=(c*vx-s*vy,s*vx+c*vy,vz). Axes are cabinet x/y at declared yaw and world +z. xyz positions in meters; native actions dimensionless,1unit=0.01m command.
observation_transform.orientation_definition: Normalize q=raw[7:11] in xyzw order. Project quaternion-rotated local+y: u=(2*(qx*qy-qw*qz),1-2*(qx*qx+qz*qz)); normalize in xy, fallback world(0,1) if projection norm<1e-8. This is an observed door orientation coordinate, not an inferred hinge axis or action controller; apply C to(u_x,u_y,0) when cabinet coordinates are requested.
observation_transform.history: Encode both whole raw observations with yaw from the latest replan observation. Relative vectors use each whole observation's own declared hand,object,goal and embedded previous fields; same cabinet axes for both history elements.

action_transform.encode: Apply C to all world xyz action commands; gripper unchanged.
action_transform.decode: Apply C inverse to first3sampled channels; gripper unchanged; shared world cube clipping after decode.
action_transform.coordinate_definition: C(v)=(c*vx+s*vy,-s*vx+c*vy,vz), with (s,c)=normalize(raw[39:41]); fallback(0,1) only for norm<1e-8. C inverse(v)=(c*vx-s*vy,s*vx+c*vy,vz). Axes are cabinet x/y at declared yaw and world +z. xyz positions in meters; native actions dimensionless,1unit=0.01m command.
action_transform.normalization: passthrough(all4); rotated action components may exceed1before world decode; never local clip.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: A rigid body rotating around world z preserves its height; future handle displacement and door orientation constrain coherent opening motion. Source: task_materials.json z-hinge declaration; projected quaternion direction uses standard quaternion rotation.
Handle motion starts after initial approach at approximately step41LL and49HH (>1mm displacement). Terminal opening follows a planar curve; measured hand-handle gaps reach~0.0253m LL and~0.0271m HH.
Joint action/future-geometry denoising may make handle engagement and rotation more legible to the network than action-only imitation.

candidates.predicted_generalization_gain: May improve contact continuity by jointly learning action and future handle/hand geometry; may instead waste limited capacity or overfit two trajectory futures.

observation_transform.orientation_definition: Normalize q=raw[7:11] in xyzw order. Project quaternion-rotated local+y: u=(2*(qx*qy-qw*qz),1-2*(qx*qx+qz*qz)); normalize in xy, fallback world(0,1) if projection norm<1e-8. This is an observed door orientation coordinate, not an inferred hinge axis or action controller; apply C to(u_x,u_y,0) when cabinet coordinates are requested.
observation_transform.history: two whole observations, initial repeated; no hidden state or episode time

action_transform.encode: World xyz+gripper unchanged; fixed passthrough normalization.
action_transform.decode: Return first4sampled channels as native world action then shared cube clip.

auxiliary_spec.target_at_each_chunk_slot: For valid action slot k at demonstration start t, use declared obs[t+k+1]. Concatenate (future.object_xyz-current.object_xyz)/0.1 [3], (future.hand_xyz-future.object_xyz)/0.1 [3], future projected door local+y xy [2]. All vectors in the candidate coordinate frame frozen at replan t. No validity labels, hidden phase, rewards or success used.
auxiliary_spec.training: Append8 channels after first4 encoded action channels. Same timestep and independently drawn Gaussian epsilon per channel; one U-Net jointly denoises all12channels.
auxiliary_spec.loss: Base mean squared epsilon error on first4action channels has weight1. Add weight0.2 times mean squared epsilon error on8auxiliary channels; mean over valid temporal positions,8channels and batch. All updates and all valid positions, no warmup.
auxiliary_spec.runtime: Sample all12channels jointly with standard DDIM; discard auxiliary8channels, decode first4actions. No rollout scoring, search, termination or action correction from predicted state.

required_train_labels: for each valid slot, next-state handle displacement from replan handle, next-state hand-handle gap and projected next door local+y; currentD_N only
failure_conditions: Joint future prediction may fit narrow demonstration timing rather than contact dynamics.
Future auxiliary channels can introduce denoising interference and slow action fitting.
World-coordinate action learning may retain the x/yaw confound.
implementation_steps: Generate8future channels from currentD_N observations only.
Extend one U-Net to12channels, retain base first4loss and add masked aux epsilon weight0.2.
Discard generated future channels at runtime and check no future input dependency.
